Import from `"rive/json"`. Declares: `JsonResult`, `JsonStep`, `JsonStream`, `parseJson`

```as
/// What `parseJson` decoded: the value, or why the text is not JSON. JSON's
/// `null` decodes to a null `value` with `ok` still true.
export class JsonResult {
    /// The decoded value, null for JSON `null` or a failed parse.
    readonly value: Dynamic?;

    /// Why the text is not JSON, with the line and column, or null.
    readonly error: string?;

    /// Whether the text was valid JSON.
    get ok(): bool;
}

/// Decodes JSON `text`. Objects fill a table's string keyed part and arrays
/// its array part. An object member whose value is `null` is left out, as a
/// Luau table would, while `null` array items keep their place. Invalid text
/// returns an error instead of raising one, since fetched data can be
/// anything.
///
/// ```as
/// import { parseJson } from "rive/json";
/// import { Dynamic } from "rive/dynamic";
///
/// let result = parseJson('{"rows":[{"value":3}]}');
/// if (result.ok) {
///     let first = Dynamic.at(Dynamic.get(result.value, "rows"), 0);
///     let value = Dynamic.asNumber(Dynamic.get(first, "value")); // 3
/// }
/// ```
export function parseJson(text: string): JsonResult;

/// What `JsonStream.step` found.
export const enum JsonStep {
    /// `item` holds the next value.
    item = 0,

    /// The text so far stops inside a value; feed more, or finish.
    needMore = 1,

    /// Every value has been read.
    done = 2,

    /// The text is not JSON; `error` says why.
    failed = 3,
}

/// Decodes JSON a piece at a time. Text can arrive in chunks of any size, and
/// each `step` reads one item of a top-level array, so a long document can be
/// spread across frames instead of stalling one. Any other top-level value is
/// a single item. Items decode as `parseJson` decodes values.
///
/// ```as
/// import { JsonStep, JsonStream } from "rive/json";
///
/// let stream = new JsonStream();
/// stream.feed(body);
/// stream.finish();
/// // Then each frame, at most 200 rows:
/// for (let i = 0; i < 200 && stream.step() == JsonStep.item; i++) {
///     rows.push(stream.item);
/// }
/// ```
export class JsonStream {
    /// The value the last `item` step read.
    item: Dynamic? = null;

    /// Why the text is not JSON, with the line and column, or null.
    get error(): string?;

    /// Appends the next chunk of text.
    feed(text: string): void;

    /// Marks the text complete, so a value cut short becomes an error rather
    /// than a wait for more.
    finish(): void;

    /// Reads up to the next item of the top-level array.
    step(): JsonStep;
}
